```cobol
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. FILEPROC.
       AUTHOR. ENTERPRISE-COBOL.
       DATE-WRITTEN. 2024-01-15.
      *================================================================*
      * PROGRAM: FILEPROC                                              *
      * PURPOSE: Read input file, validate records, write valid output *
      * INPUT:   INFILE  - Sequential input file                       *
      * OUTPUT:  OUTFILE - Valid records                               *
      *          ERRFILE - Error records                               *
      *================================================================*
       
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       CONFIGURATION SECTION.
       SOURCE-COMPUTER. IBM-ZOS.
       OBJECT-COMPUTER. IBM-ZOS.
       
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT INFILE  ASSIGN TO INDD
               FILE STATUS IS WS-INFILE-STATUS.
           SELECT OUTFILE ASSIGN TO OUTDD
               FILE STATUS IS WS-OUTFILE-STATUS.
           SELECT ERRFILE ASSIGN TO ERRDD
               FILE STATUS IS WS-ERRFILE-STATUS.
       
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       
       FD  INFILE
           RECORDING MODE IS F
           RECORD CONTAINS 100 CHARACTERS
           BLOCK CONTAINS 0 RECORDS.
       01  IN-RECORD.
           05 IN-CUST-ID          PIC X(10).
           05 IN-CUST-NAME        PIC X(30).
           05 IN-CUST-BALANCE     PIC S9(9)V99.
           05 IN-CUST-STATUS      PIC X(1).
           05 IN-CUST-DATE        PIC 9(8).
           05 FILLER              PIC X(40).
       
       FD  OUTFILE
           RECORDING MODE IS F
           RECORD CONTAINS 100 CHARACTERS.
       01  OUT-RECORD             PIC X(100).
       
       FD  ERRFILE
           RECORDING MODE IS F
           RECORD CONTAINS 150 CHARACTERS.
       01  ERR-RECORD.
           05 ERR-ORIGINAL        PIC X(100).
           05 ERR-CODE            PIC X(4).
           05 ERR-MESSAGE         PIC X(46).
       
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-FILE-STATUS.
           05 WS-INFILE-STATUS    PIC XX.
           05 WS-OUTFILE-STATUS   PIC XX.
           05 WS-ERRFILE-STATUS   PIC XX.
       
       01  WS-FLAGS.
           05 WS-EOF-FLAG         PIC X(1) VALUE 'N'.
              88 END-OF-FILE      VALUE 'Y'.
              88 NOT-END-OF-FILE  VALUE 'N'.
           05 WS-VALID-FLAG       PIC X(1).
              88 RECORD-VALID     VALUE 'Y'.
              88 RECORD-INVALID   VALUE 'N'.
       
       01  WS-COUNTERS.
           05 WS-READ-COUNT       PIC 9(9) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-VALID-COUNT      PIC 9(9) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-ERROR-COUNT      PIC 9(9) VALUE 0.
       
       01  WS-WORK-AREAS.
           05 WS-CURRENT-DATE     PIC 9(8).
           05 WS-ERROR-CODE       PIC X(4).
           05 WS-ERROR-MSG        PIC X(46).
       
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       0000-MAIN.
           PERFORM 1000-INITIALIZE
           PERFORM 2000-PROCESS UNTIL END-OF-FILE
           PERFORM 9000-TERMINATE
           STOP RUN.
       
       1000-INITIALIZE.
           OPEN INPUT  INFILE
           OPEN OUTPUT OUTFILE
           OPEN OUTPUT ERRFILE
           
           IF WS-INFILE-STATUS NOT = '00'
               DISPLAY 'ERROR OPENING INPUT FILE: ' WS-INFILE-STATUS
               MOVE 8 TO RETURN-CODE
               STOP RUN
           END-IF
           
           ACCEPT WS-CURRENT-DATE FROM DATE YYYYMMDD
           
           PERFORM 1100-READ-INPUT.
       
       1100-READ-INPUT.
           READ INFILE
               AT END SET END-OF-FILE TO TRUE
               NOT AT END ADD 1 TO WS-READ-COUNT
           END-READ.
       
       2000-PROCESS.
           PERFORM 2100-VALIDATE-RECORD
           
           IF RECORD-VALID
               PERFORM 2200-WRITE-VALID
           ELSE
               PERFORM 2300-WRITE-ERROR
           END-IF
           
           PERFORM 1100-READ-INPUT.
       
       2100-VALIDATE-RECORD.
           SET RECORD-VALID TO TRUE
           INITIALIZE WS-ERROR-CODE WS-ERROR-MSG
           
           IF IN-CUST-ID = SPACES OR IN-CUST-ID = LOW-VALUES
               SET RECORD-INVALID TO TRUE
               MOVE 'E001' TO WS-ERROR-CODE
               MOVE 'CUSTOMER ID IS BLANK' TO WS-ERROR-MSG
           END-IF
           
           IF RECORD-VALID AND IN-CUST-BALANCE NOT NUMERIC
               SET RECORD-INVALID TO TRUE
               MOVE 'E002' TO WS-ERROR-CODE
               MOVE 'BALANCE IS NOT NUMERIC' TO WS-ERROR-MSG
           END-IF
           
           IF RECORD-VALID AND IN-CUST-STATUS NOT = 'A' AND 'I' AND 'C'
               SET RECORD-INVALID TO TRUE
               MOVE 'E003' TO WS-ERROR-CODE
               MOVE 'INVALID STATUS CODE' TO WS-ERROR-MSG
           END-IF
           
           IF RECORD-VALID AND IN-CUST-DATE > WS-CURRENT-DATE
               SET RECORD-INVALID TO TRUE
               MOVE 'E004' TO WS-ERROR-CODE
               MOVE 'DATE IS IN THE FUTURE' TO WS-ERROR-MSG
           END-IF.
       
       2200-WRITE-VALID.
           MOVE IN-RECORD TO OUT-RECORD
           WRITE OUT-RECORD
           ADD 1 TO WS-VALID-COUNT.
       
       2300-WRITE-ERROR.
           MOVE IN-RECORD TO ERR-ORIGINAL
           MOVE WS-ERROR-CODE TO ERR-CODE
           MOVE WS-ERROR-MSG TO ERR-MESSAGE
           WRITE ERR-RECORD
           ADD 1 TO WS-ERROR-COUNT.
       
       9000-TERMINATE.
           CLOSE INFILE OUTFILE ERRFILE
           
           DISPLAY '=================================='
           DISPLAY 'PROCESSING COMPLETE'
           DISPLAY '=================================='
           DISPLAY 'RECORDS READ:    ' WS-READ-COUNT
           DISPLAY 'RECORDS VALID:   ' WS-VALID-COUNT
           DISPLAY 'RECORDS IN ERROR:' WS-ERROR-COUNT
           DISPLAY '=================================='.
```

Write COBOL to handle VSAM KSDS file with full error handling

```cobol
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. VSAMPROC.
      *================================================================*
      * VSAM KSDS Processing with Complete Error Handling              *
      *================================================================*
       
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT CUSTOMER-FILE ASSIGN TO CUSTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS INDEXED
               ACCESS MODE IS DYNAMIC
               RECORD KEY IS CUST-KEY
               ALTERNATE RECORD KEY IS CUST-NAME-KEY
                   WITH DUPLICATES
               FILE STATUS IS WS-VSAM-STATUS
                              WS-VSAM-FEEDBACK.
       
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  CUSTOMER-FILE.
       01  CUSTOMER-RECORD.
           05 CUST-KEY            PIC X(10).
           05 CUST-NAME-KEY       PIC X(30).
           05 CUST-ADDRESS        PIC X(50).
           05 CUST-BALANCE        PIC S9(9)V99 COMP-3.
           05 CUST-LAST-ACTIVITY  PIC 9(8).
           05 CUST-STATUS         PIC X(1).
           05 FILLER              PIC X(50).
       
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-VSAM-STATUS         PIC XX.
           88 VSAM-OK             VALUE '00'.
           88 VSAM-EOF            VALUE '10'.
           88 VSAM-DUPKEY         VALUE '22'.
           88 VSAM-NOTFND         VALUE '23'.
           88 VSAM-NOSPACE        VALUE '24'.
       
       01  WS-VSAM-FEEDBACK       PIC 9(3).
       
       01  WS-FUNCTION            PIC X(6).
           88 FUNC-READ           VALUE 'READ'.
           88 FUNC-WRITE          VALUE 'WRITE'.
           88 FUNC-REWRITE        VALUE 'REWRIT'.
           88 FUNC-DELETE         VALUE 'DELETE'.
           88 FUNC-START          VALUE 'START'.
       
       01  WS-SEARCH-KEY          PIC X(10).
       01  WS-RECORDS-PROCESSED   PIC 9(7) VALUE 0.
       
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       0000-MAIN.
           PERFORM 1000-OPEN-FILE
           PERFORM 2000-PROCESS-REQUESTS
           PERFORM 9000-CLOSE-FILE
           STOP RUN.
       
       1000-OPEN-FILE.
           OPEN I-O CUSTOMER-FILE
           IF NOT VSAM-OK
               PERFORM 8000-VSAM-ERROR
               MOVE 12 TO RETURN-CODE
               STOP RUN
           END-IF.
       
       2000-PROCESS-REQUESTS.
      *    Example: Read by key
           MOVE 'CUST000001' TO CUST-KEY
           MOVE 'READ' TO WS-FUNCTION
           PERFORM 3000-READ-RANDOM
           
      *    Example: Browse all records
           PERFORM 4000-BROWSE-FILE
           
      *    Example: Update a record
           MOVE 'REWRIT' TO WS-FUNCTION
           ADD 100.00 TO CUST-BALANCE
           PERFORM 5000-UPDATE-RECORD.
       
       3000-READ-RANDOM.
           READ CUSTOMER-FILE
               INVALID KEY
                   PERFORM 8100-HANDLE-READ-ERROR
               NOT INVALID KEY
                   ADD 1 TO WS-RECORDS-PROCESSED
                   DISPLAY 'FOUND: ' CUST-KEY ' ' CUST-NAME-KEY
           END-READ.
       
       4000-BROWSE-FILE.
           MOVE LOW-VALUES TO CUST-KEY
           MOVE 'START' TO WS-FUNCTION
           START CUSTOMER-FILE KEY >= CUST-KEY
               INVALID KEY
                   DISPLAY 'FILE IS EMPTY'
                   GO TO 4000-EXIT
           END-START
           
           PERFORM UNTIL VSAM-EOF
               READ CUSTOMER-FILE NEXT
                   AT END
                       CONTINUE
                   NOT AT END
                       DISPLAY CUST-KEY ' ' CUST-NAME-KEY 
                               ' BAL=' CUST-BALANCE
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM.
       4000-EXIT.
           EXIT.
       
       5000-UPDATE-RECORD.
           REWRITE CUSTOMER-RECORD
               INVALID KEY
                   PERFORM 8200-HANDLE-WRITE-ERROR
               NOT INVALID KEY
                   DISPLAY 'RECORD UPDATED: ' CUST-KEY
           END-REWRITE.
       
       6000-ADD-RECORD.
           WRITE CUSTOMER-RECORD
               INVALID KEY
                   IF VSAM-DUPKEY
                       DISPLAY 'DUPLICATE KEY: ' CUST-KEY
                   ELSE IF VSAM-NOSPACE
                       DISPLAY 'FILE IS FULL'
                   ELSE
                       PERFORM 8200-HANDLE-WRITE-ERROR
                   END-IF
               NOT INVALID KEY
                   DISPLAY 'RECORD ADDED: ' CUST-KEY
           END-WRITE.
       
       7000-DELETE-RECORD.
           DELETE CUSTOMER-FILE
               INVALID KEY
                   PERFORM 8100-HANDLE-READ-ERROR
               NOT INVALID KEY
                   DISPLAY 'RECORD DELETED: ' CUST-KEY
           END-DELETE.
       
       8000-VSAM-ERROR.
           DISPLAY '*** VSAM ERROR ***'
           DISPLAY 'FUNCTION: ' WS-FUNCTION
           DISPLAY 'STATUS:   ' WS-VSAM-STATUS
           DISPLAY 'FEEDBACK: ' WS-VSAM-FEEDBACK
           EVALUATE WS-VSAM-STATUS
               WHEN '00' DISPLAY 'SUCCESSFUL'
               WHEN '10' DISPLAY 'END OF FILE'
               WHEN '22' DISPLAY 'DUPLICATE KEY'
               WHEN '23' DISPLAY 'RECORD NOT FOUND'
               WHEN '24' DISPLAY 'NO SPACE ON VOLUME'
               WHEN '35' DISPLAY 'FILE NOT FOUND'
               WHEN '39' DISPLAY 'FILE MISMATCH'
               WHEN '41' DISPLAY 'FILE ALREADY OPEN'
               WHEN '42' DISPLAY 'FILE NOT OPEN'
               WHEN '46' DISPLAY 'NO VALID NEXT RECORD'
               WHEN '47' DISPLAY 'READ NOT ALLOWED'
               WHEN '48' DISPLAY 'WRITE NOT ALLOWED'
               WHEN '49' DISPLAY 'REWRITE/DELETE NOT ALLOWED'
               WHEN OTHER DISPLAY 'UNKNOWN ERROR'
           END-EVALUATE.
       
       8100-HANDLE-READ-ERROR.
           IF VSAM-NOTFND
               DISPLAY 'RECORD NOT FOUND: ' CUST-KEY
           ELSE
               PERFORM 8000-VSAM-ERROR
           END-IF.
       
       8200-HANDLE-WRITE-ERROR.
           PERFORM 8000-VSAM-ERROR.
       
       9000-CLOSE-FILE.
           CLOSE CUSTOMER-FILE.
```

Write COBOL with DB2 cursor processing and commit logic

```cobol
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. DB2BATCH.
      *================================================================*
      * DB2 Batch Processing with Cursor and Commit Point Logic        *
      *================================================================*
       
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       
           EXEC SQL INCLUDE SQLCA END-EXEC.
           EXEC SQL INCLUDE CUSTOMER END-EXEC.
       
       01  WS-SQLCODE             PIC S9(9) COMP VALUE 0.
       01  WS-COMMIT-COUNT        PIC 9(5) VALUE 0.
       01  WS-COMMIT-FREQUENCY    PIC 9(5) VALUE 1000.
       01  WS-TOTAL-PROCESSED     PIC 9(9) VALUE 0.
       01  WS-TOTAL-UPDATED       PIC 9(9) VALUE 0.
       01  WS-TOTAL-ERRORS        PIC 9(9) VALUE 0.
       
       01  WS-CURRENT-TIMESTAMP.
           05 WS-CURR-DATE        PIC X(10).
           05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE '-'.
           05 WS-CURR-TIME        PIC X(8).
       
       01  WS-HOST-VARIABLES.
           05 HV-CUST-ID          PIC X(10).
           05 HV-CUST-NAME        PIC X(50).
           05 HV-BALANCE          PIC S9(9)V99 COMP-3.
           05 HV-STATUS           PIC X(1).
           05 HV-LAST-UPDATE      PIC X(26).
       
       01  WS-NULL-INDICATORS.
           05 NI-CUST-NAME        PIC S9(4) COMP.
           05 NI-BALANCE          PIC S9(4) COMP.
       
           EXEC SQL DECLARE CUST_CURSOR CURSOR WITH HOLD FOR
               SELECT CUST_ID,
                      CUST_NAME,
                      BALANCE,
                      STATUS,
                      LAST_UPDATE
               FROM CUSTOMER_TABLE
               WHERE STATUS = 'A'
                 AND BALANCE > 0
               FOR UPDATE OF BALANCE, LAST_UPDATE
           END-EXEC.
       
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       0000-MAIN.
           PERFORM 1000-INITIALIZE
           PERFORM 2000-PROCESS-CUSTOMERS
           PERFORM 9000-TERMINATE
           GOBACK.
       
       1000-INITIALIZE.
           DISPLAY 'DB2BATCH STARTED'
           EXEC SQL
               SELECT CURRENT TIMESTAMP
               INTO :WS-CURRENT-TIMESTAMP
               FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1
           END-EXEC
           
           DISPLAY 'PROCESSING TIME: ' WS-CURRENT-TIMESTAMP
           
           EXEC SQL OPEN CUST_CURSOR END-EXEC
           IF SQLCODE NOT = 0
               DISPLAY 'ERROR OPENING CURSOR: ' SQLCODE
               PERFORM 8000-DB2-ERROR
               MOVE 12 TO RETURN-CODE
               GOBACK
           END-IF.
       
       2000-PROCESS-CUSTOMERS.
           PERFORM 2100-FETCH-CUSTOMER
           PERFORM UNTIL SQLCODE = 100
               PERFORM 2200-UPDATE-CUSTOMER
               PERFORM 2300-CHECK-COMMIT
               PERFORM 2100-FETCH-CUSTOMER
           END-PERFORM.
       
       2100-FETCH-CUSTOMER.
           EXEC SQL
               FETCH CUST_CURSOR
               INTO :HV-CUST-ID,
                    :HV-CUST-NAME :NI-CUST-NAME,
                    :HV-BALANCE   :NI-BALANCE,
                    :HV-STATUS,
                    :HV-LAST-UPDATE
           END-EXEC
           
           MOVE SQLCODE TO WS-SQLCODE
           
           IF SQLCODE = 0
               ADD 1 TO WS-TOTAL-PROCESSED
           ELSE IF SQLCODE NOT = 100
               PERFORM 8000-DB2-ERROR
           END-IF.
       
       2200-UPDATE-CUSTOMER.
      *    Apply 2% interest to positive balances
           IF HV-BALANCE > 0
               COMPUTE HV-BALANCE = HV-BALANCE * 1.02
               
               EXEC SQL
                   UPDATE CUSTOMER_TABLE
                   SET BALANCE = :HV-BALANCE,
                       LAST_UPDATE = CURRENT TIMESTAMP
                   WHERE CURRENT OF CUST_CURSOR
               END-EXEC
               
               IF SQLCODE = 0
                   ADD 1 TO WS-TOTAL-UPDATED
                   ADD 1 TO WS-COMMIT-COUNT
               ELSE
                   ADD 1 TO WS-TOTAL-ERRORS
                   DISPLAY 'UPDATE ERROR FOR: ' HV-CUST-ID
                   PERFORM 8000-DB2-ERROR
               END-IF
           END-IF.
       
       2300-CHECK-COMMIT.
           IF WS-COMMIT-COUNT >= WS-COMMIT-FREQUENCY
               EXEC SQL COMMIT END-EXEC
               IF SQLCODE = 0
                   DISPLAY 'COMMIT AT: ' WS-TOTAL-PROCESSED ' RECORDS'
                   MOVE 0 TO WS-COMMIT-COUNT
               ELSE
                   DISPLAY 'COMMIT FAILED'
                   PERFORM 8000-DB2-ERROR
                   EXEC SQL ROLLBACK END-EXEC
                   MOVE 16 TO RETURN-CODE
                   GOBACK
               END-IF
           END-IF.
       
       8000-DB2-ERROR.
           DISPLAY '*** DB2 ERROR ***'
           DISPLAY 'SQLCODE:  ' SQLCODE
           DISPLAY 'SQLERRMC: ' SQLERRMC
           DISPLAY 'SQLERRD:  ' SQLERRD(3)
           
           EVALUATE SQLCODE
               WHEN 0     DISPLAY 'SUCCESSFUL'
               WHEN 100   DISPLAY 'NOT FOUND / END OF DATA'
               WHEN -803  DISPLAY 'DUPLICATE KEY'
               WHEN -811  DISPLAY 'MORE THAN ONE ROW'
               WHEN -818  DISPLAY 'TIMESTAMP MISMATCH'
               WHEN -904  DISPLAY 'RESOURCE UNAVAILABLE'
               WHEN -911  DISPLAY 'DEADLOCK OR TIMEOUT'
               WHEN -913  DISPLAY 'DEADLOCK VICTIM'
               WHEN OTHER DISPLAY 'CHECK DB2 CODES MANUAL'
           END-EVALUATE.
       
       9000-TERMINATE.
           EXEC SQL CLOSE CUST_CURSOR END-EXEC
           EXEC SQL COMMIT END-EXEC
           
           DISPLAY '=================================='
           DISPLAY 'DB2BATCH COMPLETE'
           DISPLAY '=================================='
           DISPLAY 'RECORDS PROCESSED: ' WS-TOTAL-PROCESSED
           DISPLAY 'RECORDS UPDATED:   ' WS-TOTAL-UPDATED
           DISPLAY 'ERRORS:            ' WS-TOTAL-ERRORS
           DISPLAY '=================================='.
```

Write COBOL CICS program with BMS map handling

```cobol
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. CUSTINQ.
      *================================================================*
      * CICS Customer Inquiry Program with BMS Map                     *
      *================================================================*
       
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       
       01  WS-COMMAREA.
           05 WS-COMM-STATE       PIC X(2).
              88 STATE-INITIAL    VALUE 'IN'.
              88 STATE-DISPLAY    VALUE 'DS'.
              88 STATE-UPDATE     VALUE 'UP'.
           05 WS-COMM-CUST-ID     PIC X(10).
           05 WS-COMM-MSG         PIC X(50).
       
       01  WS-RESPONSE            PIC S9(8) COMP.
       01  WS-RESPONSE2           PIC S9(8) COMP.
       
       01  WS-CUSTOMER-RECORD.
           05 WS-CUST-ID          PIC X(10).
           05 WS-CUST-NAME        PIC X(30).
           05 WS-CUST-ADDR        PIC X(50).
           05 WS-CUST-PHONE       PIC X(15).
           05 WS-CUST-BALANCE     PIC S9(9)V99 COMP-3.
           05 WS-CUST-STATUS      PIC X(1).
       
       COPY CUSTMAP.
       
       LINKAGE SECTION.
       01  DFHCOMMAREA            PIC X(62).
       
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       0000-MAIN.
           EVALUATE TRUE
               WHEN EIBCALEN = 0
                   PERFORM 1000-FIRST-TIME
               WHEN EIBAID = DFHCLEAR
                   PERFORM 9000-RETURN-TRANS
               WHEN EIBAID = DFHPF3
                   PERFORM 9100-END-SESSION
               WHEN EIBAID = DFHENTER
                   PERFORM 2000-PROCESS-INPUT
               WHEN EIBAID = DFHPF5
                   PERFORM 3000-UPDATE-RECORD
               WHEN OTHER
                   MOVE 'INVALID KEY PRESSED' TO WS-COMM-MSG
                   PERFORM 4000-SEND-MAP
           END-EVALUATE
           
           PERFORM 9000-RETURN-TRANS.
       
       1000-FIRST-TIME.
           INITIALIZE CUSTMAPO
           MOVE 'ENTER CUSTOMER ID AND PRESS ENTER' TO MSGO
           SET STATE-INITIAL TO TRUE
           PERFORM 4100-SEND-MAP-ERASE.
       
       2000-PROCESS-INPUT.
           PERFORM 2100-RECEIVE-MAP
           
           IF CUSTIDI = SPACES OR CUSTIDI = LOW-VALUES
               MOVE 'CUSTOMER ID IS REQUIRED' TO MSGO
               MOVE -1 TO CUSTIDL
               PERFORM 4200-SEND-MAP-DATAONLY
               GO TO 2000-EXIT
           END-IF
           
           MOVE CUSTIDI TO WS-CUST-ID
           PERFORM 2200-READ-CUSTOMER
           
           IF WS-RESPONSE = DFHRESP(NORMAL)
               PERFORM 2300-DISPLAY-CUSTOMER
               SET STATE-DISPLAY TO TRUE
           ELSE
               MOVE 'CUSTOMER NOT FOUND' TO MSGO
               MOVE -1 TO CUSTIDL
               PERFORM 4200-SEND-MAP-DATAONLY
           END-IF.
       2000-EXIT.
           EXIT.
       
       2100-RECEIVE-MAP.
           EXEC CICS RECEIVE MAP('CUSTMAP')
               MAPSET('CUSTSET')
               INTO(CUSTMAPI)
               RESP(WS-RESPONSE)
               RESP2(WS-RESPONSE2)
           END-EXEC
           
           IF WS-RESPONSE NOT = DFHRESP(NORMAL)
               IF WS-RESPONSE = DFHRESP(MAPFAIL)
                   MOVE 'NO DATA ENTERED' TO MSGO
               ELSE
                   PERFORM 8000-CICS-ERROR
               END-IF
           END-IF.
       
       2200-READ-CUSTOMER.
           EXEC CICS READ FILE('CUSTFILE')
               INTO(WS-CUSTOMER-RECORD)
               RIDFLD(WS-CUST-ID)
               RESP(WS-RESPONSE)
               RESP2(WS-RESPONSE2)
           END-EXEC.
       
       2300-DISPLAY-CUSTOMER.
           MOVE WS-CUST-ID      TO CUSTIDO
           MOVE WS-CUST-NAME    TO NAMEO
           MOVE WS-CUST-ADDR    TO ADDRO
           MOVE WS-CUST-PHONE   TO PHONEO
           MOVE WS-CUST-BALANCE TO BALANCEO
           MOVE WS-CUST-STATUS  TO STATUSO
           MOVE 'RECORD FOUND - PF5 TO UPDATE, PF3 TO EXIT' TO MSGO
           PERFORM 4200-SEND-MAP-DATAONLY.
       
       3000-UPDATE-RECORD.
           IF NOT STATE-DISPLAY
               MOVE 'DISPLAY RECORD FIRST' TO MSGO
               PERFORM 4200-SEND-MAP-DATAONLY
               GO TO 3000-EXIT
           END-IF
           
           PERFORM 2100-RECEIVE-MAP
           PERFORM 3100-VALIDATE-INPUT
           
           IF WS-RESPONSE = DFHRESP(NORMAL)
               PERFORM 3200-REWRITE-RECORD
           END-IF.
       3000-EXIT.
           EXIT.
       
       3100-VALIDATE-INPUT.
           MOVE DFHRESP(NORMAL) TO WS-RESPONSE
           
           IF NAMEI = SPACES
               MOVE 'NAME IS REQUIRED' TO MSGO
               MOVE -1 TO NAMEL
               MOVE DFHRESP(ERROR) TO WS-RESPONSE
           END-IF.
       
       3200-REWRITE-RECORD.
           MOVE NAMEI    TO WS-CUST-NAME
           MOVE ADDRI    TO WS-CUST-ADDR
           MOVE PHONEI   TO WS-CUST-PHONE
           MOVE STATUSI  TO WS-CUST-STATUS
           
           EXEC CICS READ FILE('CUSTFILE')
               INTO(WS-CUSTOMER-RECORD)
               RIDFLD(WS-CUST-ID)
               UPDATE
               RESP(WS-RESPONSE)
           END-EXEC
           
           IF WS-RESPONSE = DFHRESP(NORMAL)
               EXEC CICS REWRITE FILE('CUSTFILE')
                   FROM(WS-CUSTOMER-RECORD)
                   RESP(WS-RESPONSE)
               END-EXEC
               
               IF WS-RESPONSE = DFHRESP(NORMAL)
                   MOVE 'RECORD UPDATED SUCCESSFULLY' TO MSGO
               ELSE
                   PERFORM 8000-CICS-ERROR
               END-IF
           ELSE
               PERFORM 8000-CICS-ERROR
           END-IF
           
           PERFORM 4200-SEND-MAP-DATAONLY.
       
       4000-SEND-MAP.
           EXEC CICS SEND MAP('CUSTMAP')
               MAPSET('CUSTSET')
               FROM(CUSTMAPO)
               RESP(WS-RESPONSE)
           END-EXEC.
       
       4100-SEND-MAP-ERASE.
           EXEC CICS SEND MAP('CUSTMAP')
               MAPSET('CUSTSET')
               FROM(CUSTMAPO)
               ERASE
               RESP(WS-RESPONSE)
           END-EXEC.
       
       4200-SEND-MAP-DATAONLY.
           EXEC CICS SEND MAP('CUSTMAP')
               MAPSET('CUSTSET')
               FROM(CUSTMAPO)
               DATAONLY
               CURSOR
               RESP(WS-RESPONSE)
           END-EXEC.
       
       8000-CICS-ERROR.
           MOVE 'CICS ERROR OCCURRED' TO MSGO
           STRING 'RESP=' DELIMITED SIZE
                  WS-RESPONSE DELIMITED SIZE
                  ' RESP2=' DELIMITED SIZE
                  WS-RESPONSE2 DELIMITED SIZE
               INTO MSGO
           END-STRING.
       
       9000-RETURN-TRANS.
           EXEC CICS RETURN
               TRANSID('CINQ')
               COMMAREA(WS-COMMAREA)
               LENGTH(LENGTH OF WS-COMMAREA)
           END-EXEC.
       
       9100-END-SESSION.
           EXEC CICS SEND TEXT
               FROM('SESSION ENDED - GOODBYE')
               ERASE
           END-EXEC
           EXEC CICS RETURN END-EXEC.
```

Write COBOL with SORT using INPUT and OUTPUT PROCEDURE

```cobol
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. SORTPROC.
      *================================================================*
      * Internal SORT with INPUT and OUTPUT Procedures                 *
      * Reads transactions, sorts by date/amount, writes summary       *
      *================================================================*
       
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT TRANS-FILE ASSIGN TO TRANSIN
               FILE STATUS IS WS-TRANS-STATUS.
           SELECT SORT-FILE ASSIGN TO SORTWORK.
           SELECT REPORT-FILE ASSIGN TO RPTOUT
               FILE STATUS IS WS-RPT-STATUS.
       
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       
       FD  TRANS-FILE.
       01  TRANS-RECORD.
           05 TR-ACCOUNT         PIC X(10).
           05 TR-DATE            PIC 9(8).
           05 TR-TYPE            PIC X(1).

           05 FILLER             PIC X(3) VALUE SPACES.

           05 FILLER             PIC X(10) VALUE 'CREDITS:'.
           05 TD-CREDITS         PIC $$$,$$$,$$9.99-.
           05 FILLER             PIC X(5) VALUE SPACES.
           05 FILLER             PIC X(5) VALUE 'NET:'.
           05 TD-NET             PIC $$$,$$$,$$9.99-.
       
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       0000-MAIN.
           SORT SORT-FILE
               ON ASCENDING KEY SR-DATE
               ON DESCENDING KEY SR-AMOUNT
               INPUT PROCEDURE IS 1000-INPUT-PROC
               OUTPUT PROCEDURE IS 2000-OUTPUT-PROC
           
           DISPLAY 'SORT COMPLETE'
           DISPLAY 'INPUT RECORDS:  ' WS-INPUT-COUNT
           DISPLAY 'OUTPUT RECORDS: ' WS-OUTPUT-COUNT
           STOP RUN.
       
       1000-INPUT-PROC SECTION.
       1000-BEGIN.
           OPEN INPUT TRANS-FILE
           IF WS-TRANS-STATUS NOT = '00'
               DISPLAY 'ERROR OPENING TRANS FILE'
               STOP RUN
           END-IF
           
           PERFORM 1100-READ-TRANS
           PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-FILE
               PERFORM 1200-PROCESS-INPUT
               PERFORM 1100-READ-TRANS
           END-PERFORM
           
           CLOSE TRANS-FILE.
       1000-EXIT.
           EXIT.
       
       1100-READ-TRANS.
           READ TRANS-FILE
               AT END SET END-OF-FILE TO TRUE
           END-READ.
       
       1200-PROCESS-INPUT.
           ADD 1 TO WS-INPUT-COUNT
           
      *    Filter: Only process records from current year
           IF TR-DATE >= 20240101 AND TR-DATE <= 20241231
               MOVE TR-DATE    TO SR-DATE
               MOVE TR-AMOUNT  TO SR-AMOUNT
               MOVE TR-ACCOUNT TO SR-ACCOUNT
               MOVE TR-TYPE    TO SR-TYPE
               MOVE TR-DESC    TO SR-DESC
               RELEASE SORT-RECORD
           END-IF.
       
       2000-OUTPUT-PROC SECTION.
       2000-BEGIN.
           OPEN OUTPUT REPORT-FILE
           PERFORM 2100-WRITE-HEADERS
           
           MOVE 'N' TO WS-EOF-FLAG
           PERFORM 2200-RETURN-SORTED
           PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-FILE
               PERFORM 2300-PROCESS-OUTPUT
               PERFORM 2200-RETURN-SORTED
           END-PERFORM
           
           IF WS-PREV-DATE > 0
               PERFORM 2400-WRITE-DATE-SUBTOTAL
           END-IF
           
           PERFORM 2500-WRITE-TOTALS
           CLOSE REPORT-FILE.
       2000-EXIT.
           EXIT.
       
       2100-WRITE-HEADERS.
           MOVE WS-HEADER-LINE TO REPORT-LINE
           WRITE REPORT-LINE AFTER PAGE
           MOVE SPACES TO REPORT-LINE
           WRITE REPORT-LINE.
       
       2200-RETURN-SORTED.
           RETURN SORT-FILE
               AT END SET END-OF-FILE TO TRUE
           END-RETURN.
       
       2300-PROCESS-OUTPUT.
           IF WS-PREV-DATE > 0 AND SR-DATE NOT = WS-PREV-DATE
               PERFORM 2400-WRITE-DATE-SUBTOTAL
           END-IF
           
           ADD 1 TO WS-OUTPUT-COUNT
           MOVE SR-DATE    TO DL-DATE
           MOVE SR-ACCOUNT TO DL-ACCOUNT
           MOVE SR-AMOUNT  TO DL-AMOUNT
           MOVE SR-DESC    TO DL-DESC
           
           IF SR-TYPE = 'D'
               MOVE 'DEBIT' TO DL-TYPE
               ADD 1 TO WS-DEBIT-COUNT
               ADD SR-AMOUNT TO WS-TOTAL-DEBITS
           ELSE
               MOVE 'CREDIT' TO DL-TYPE
               ADD 1 TO WS-CREDIT-COUNT
               ADD SR-AMOUNT TO WS-TOTAL-CREDITS
           END-IF
           
           ADD SR-AMOUNT TO WS-DATE-TOTAL
           MOVE SR-DATE TO WS-PREV-DATE
           
           MOVE WS-DETAIL-LINE TO REPORT-LINE
           WRITE REPORT-LINE.
       
       2400-WRITE-DATE-SUBTOTAL.
           MOVE WS-PREV-DATE TO DSL-DATE
           MOVE WS-DATE-TOTAL TO DSL-AMOUNT
           MOVE WS-DATE-SUBTOTAL-LINE TO REPORT-LINE
           WRITE REPORT-LINE
           MOVE SPACES TO REPORT-LINE
           WRITE REPORT-LINE
           MOVE 0 TO WS-DATE-TOTAL.
       
       2500-WRITE-TOTALS.
           COMPUTE WS-NET-AMOUNT = 
               WS-TOTAL-CREDITS - WS-TOTAL-DEBITS
           
           MOVE SPACES TO REPORT-LINE
           WRITE REPORT-LINE
           MOVE WS-TOTAL-LINE TO REPORT-LINE
           WRITE REPORT-LINE
           
           MOVE WS-TOTAL-DEBITS  TO TD-DEBITS
           MOVE WS-TOTAL-CREDITS TO TD-CREDITS
           MOVE WS-NET-AMOUNT    TO TD-NET
           MOVE WS-TOTAL-DETAIL TO REPORT-LINE
           WRITE REPORT-LINE.
```

```cobol
           STOP RUN.
       
       1000-PARSE-CSV.
      *    Parse CSV: "John,Doe,123 Main St,New York,10001"
           MOVE 'John,Doe,123 Main St,New York,10001' 
               TO WS-INPUT-STRING
           
           INITIALIZE WS-CSV-FIELDS
           
           UNSTRING WS-INPUT-STRING
               DELIMITED BY WS-COMMA
               INTO CSV-FIELD-1
                    CSV-FIELD-2
                    CSV-FIELD-3
                    CSV-FIELD-4
                    CSV-FIELD-5
               TALLYING IN WS-FIELD-COUNT
               ON OVERFLOW
                   DISPLAY 'TOO MANY FIELDS IN CSV'
                   SET STRING-OVERFLOW TO TRUE
           END-UNSTRING
           
           DISPLAY 'PARSED ' WS-FIELD-COUNT ' FIELDS:'
           DISPLAY '  1: ' CSV-FIELD-1
           DISPLAY '  2: ' CSV-FIELD-2
           DISPLAY '  3: ' CSV-FIELD-3
           DISPLAY '  4: ' CSV-FIELD-4
           DISPLAY '  5: ' CSV-FIELD-5.
       
       2000-FORMAT-NAME.
      *    Input: "JOHN|QUINCY|ADAMS"
      *    Output: "Adams, John Q."
           MOVE 'JOHN|QUINCY|ADAMS' TO WS-INPUT-STRING
           INITIALIZE WS-NAME-PARTS
           
           UNSTRING WS-INPUT-STRING
               DELIMITED BY WS-PIPE
               INTO WS-FIRST-NAME
                    WS-MIDDLE-NAME
                    WS-LAST-NAME
           END-UNSTRING
           
      *    Format: Last, First M.
           INITIALIZE WS-FORMATTED-NAME
           MOVE 1 TO WS-POINTER
           
           STRING FUNCTION LOWER-CASE(WS-LAST-NAME(2:))
                  DELIMITED SIZE
               INTO WS-LAST-NAME
               WITH POINTER WS-POINTER
           END-STRING
           
           MOVE 1 TO WS-POINTER
           STRING WS-LAST-NAME DELIMITED SPACE
                  ', ' DELIMITED SIZE
                  WS-FIRST-NAME DELIMITED SPACE
                  ' ' DELIMITED SIZE
                  WS-MIDDLE-NAME(1:1) DELIMITED SIZE
                  '.' DELIMITED SIZE
               INTO WS-FORMATTED-NAME
               WITH POINTER WS-POINTER
           END-STRING
           
           DISPLAY 'FORMATTED NAME: ' WS-FORMATTED-NAME.
       
       3000-FORMAT-DATE.
      *    Input: "12/25/2024"
      *    Output: "2024-12-25"
           MOVE '12/25/2024' TO WS-INPUT-STRING
           
           UNSTRING WS-INPUT-STRING
               DELIMITED BY WS-SLASH
               INTO WS-MONTH
                    WS-DAY
                    WS-YEAR
           END-UNSTRING
           
           INITIALIZE WS-FORMATTED-DATE
           STRING WS-YEAR DELIMITED SIZE
                  '-' DELIMITED SIZE
                  WS-MONTH DELIMITED SIZE
                  '-' DELIMITED SIZE
                  WS-DAY DELIMITED SIZE
               INTO WS-FORMATTED-DATE
           END-STRING
           
           DISPLAY 'FORMATTED DATE: ' WS-FORMATTED-DATE.
       
       4000-BUILD-DELIMITED.
      *    Build pipe-delimited output with POINTER
           INITIALIZE WS-OUTPUT-STRING
           MOVE 1 TO WS-POINTER
           
           STRING 'FIELD1' DELIMITED SIZE
                  WS-PIPE DELIMITED SIZE
                  'FIELD2' DELIMITED SIZE
                  WS-PIPE DELIMITED SIZE
                  'FIELD3' DELIMITED SIZE
                  WS-PIPE DELIMITED SIZE
               INTO WS-OUTPUT-STRING
               WITH POINTER WS-POINTER
               ON OVERFLOW
                   DISPLAY 'OUTPUT STRING OVERFLOW'
           END-STRING
           
           DISPLAY 'BUILT STRING: ' WS-OUTPUT-STRING
           DISPLAY 'FINAL POINTER: ' WS-POINTER.
       
       5000-COUNT-DELIMITERS.
      *    Count occurrences of delimiter
           MOVE 'A,B,C,D,E,F' TO WS-INPUT-STRING
           MOVE 0 TO WS-DELIMITER-COUNT
           
           INSPECT WS-INPUT-STRING
               TALLYING WS-DELIMITER-COUNT
               FOR ALL WS-COMMA
           
           DISPLAY 'COMMA COUNT: ' WS-DELIMITER-COUNT
           
      *    Replace delimiters
           INSPECT WS-INPUT-STRING
               REPLACING ALL WS-COMMA BY WS-PIPE
           
           DISPLAY 'AFTER REPLACE: ' WS-INPUT-STRING.
```

```cobol
           05 WS-GRAND-TOTAL      PIC S9(13)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-GRAND-COUNT      PIC 9(7) VALUE 0.
       
       01  WS-CURRENT-DATE.
           05 WS-CURR-YEAR        PIC 9(4).
           05 WS-CURR-MONTH       PIC 9(2).
           05 WS-CURR-DAY         PIC 9(2).
       
       01  WS-HEADER-1.
           05 FILLER              PIC X(40) 
              VALUE 'SALES REPORT BY REGION/BRANCH/SALESPERSON'.
           05 FILLER              PIC X(50) VALUE SPACES.
           05 FILLER              PIC X(6) VALUE 'PAGE: '.
           05 H1-PAGE             PIC ZZ9.
       
       01  WS-HEADER-2.
           05 FILLER              PIC X(10) VALUE 'RUN DATE: '.
           05 H2-DATE             PIC 99/99/9999.
       
       01  WS-HEADER-3.
           05 FILLER              PIC X(8) VALUE 'REGION'.
           05 FILLER              PIC X(8) VALUE 'BRANCH'.
           05 FILLER              PIC X(12) VALUE 'SALESPERSON'.
           05 FILLER              PIC X(12) VALUE 'DATE'.
           05 FILLER              PIC X(15) VALUE 'AMOUNT'.
           05 FILLER              PIC X(15) VALUE 'PRODUCT'.
       
       01  WS-DETAIL-LINE.
           05 DL-REGION           PIC X(6).
           05 FILLER              PIC X(2) VALUE SPACES.
           05 DL-BRANCH           PIC X(6).
           05 FILLER              PIC X(2) VALUE SPACES.
           05 DL-PERSON           PIC X(10).
           05 FILLER              PIC X(2) VALUE SPACES.
           05 DL-DATE             PIC 9999/99/99.
           05 FILLER              PIC X(2) VALUE SPACES.
           05 DL-AMOUNT           PIC $$$,$$$,$$9.99-.
           05 FILLER              PIC X(2) VALUE SPACES.
           05 DL-PRODUCT          PIC X(10).
       
       01  WS-PERSON-TOTAL-LINE.
           05 FILLER              PIC X(20) VALUE SPACES.
           05 FILLER              PIC X(20) 
              VALUE '** SALESPERSON TOTAL:'.
           05 PTL-AMOUNT          PIC $$$,$$$,$$9.99-.
           05 FILLER              PIC X(5) VALUE SPACES.
           05 PTL-COUNT           PIC ZZ,ZZ9 VALUE SPACES.
           05 FILLER              PIC X(10) VALUE ' RECORDS'.
       
       01  WS-BRANCH-TOTAL-LINE.
           05 FILLER              PIC X(15) VALUE SPACES.
           05 FILLER              PIC X(20) 
              VALUE '*** BRANCH TOTAL:'.
           05 BTL-AMOUNT          PIC $$$$,$$$,$$9.99-.
           05 FILLER              PIC X(5) VALUE SPACES.
           05 BTL-COUNT           PIC ZZZ,ZZ9.
           05 FILLER              PIC X(10) VALUE ' RECORDS'.
       
       01  WS-REGION-TOTAL-LINE.
           05 FILLER              PIC X(10) VALUE SPACES.
           05 FILLER              PIC X(20) 
              VALUE '**** REGION TOTAL:'.
           05 RTL-AMOUNT          PIC $$$$$,$$$,$$9.99-.
           05 FILLER              PIC X(5) VALUE SPACES.
           05 RTL-COUNT           PIC Z,ZZZ,ZZ9.
           05 FILLER              PIC X(10) VALUE ' RECORDS'.
       
       01  WS-GRAND-TOTAL-LINE.
           05 FILLER              PIC X(5) VALUE SPACES.
           05 FILLER              PIC X(20) 
              VALUE '***** GRAND TOTAL:'.
           05 GTL-AMOUNT          PIC $$$$$$,$$$,$$9.99-.
           05 FILLER              PIC X(5) VALUE SPACES.
           05 GTL-COUNT           PIC ZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.
           05 FILLER              PIC X(10) VALUE ' RECORDS'.
       
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       0000-MAIN.
           PERFORM 1000-INITIALIZE
           PERFORM 2000-PROCESS UNTIL END-OF-FILE
           PERFORM 3000-FINAL-TOTALS
           PERFORM 9000-TERMINATE
           STOP RUN.
       
       1000-INITIALIZE.
           OPEN INPUT SALES-FILE
           OPEN OUTPUT REPORT-FILE
           
           ACCEPT WS-CURRENT-DATE FROM DATE YYYYMMDD
           MOVE WS-CURR-MONTH TO H2-DATE(1:2)
           MOVE WS-CURR-DAY   TO H2-DATE(4:2)
           MOVE WS-CURR-YEAR  TO H2-DATE(7:4)
           
           PERFORM 1100-READ-SALES.
       
       1100-READ-SALES.
           READ SALES-FILE
               AT END SET END-OF-FILE TO TRUE
           END-READ.
       
       2000-PROCESS.
           IF IS-FIRST-RECORD
               PERFORM 2100-FIRST-RECORD
           ELSE
               PERFORM 2200-CHECK-BREAKS
           END-IF
           
           PERFORM 2300-PRINT-DETAIL
           PERFORM 2400-ACCUMULATE-TOTALS
           PERFORM 1100-READ-SALES.
       
       2100-FIRST-RECORD.
           MOVE 'N' TO WS-FIRST-RECORD
           MOVE SR-REGION TO WS-SAVE-REGION
           MOVE SR-BRANCH TO WS-SAVE-BRANCH
           MOVE SR-SALESPERSON TO WS-SAVE-PERSON.
       
       2200-CHECK-BREAKS.
           IF SR-REGION NOT = WS-SAVE-REGION
               PERFORM 2210-PERSON-BREAK
               PERFORM 2220-BRANCH-BREAK
               PERFORM 2230-REGION-BREAK
               MOVE SR-REGION TO WS-SAVE-REGION
               MOVE SR-BRANCH TO WS-SAVE-BRANCH
               MOVE SR-SALESPERSON TO WS-SAVE-PERSON
           ELSE IF SR-BRANCH NOT = WS-SAVE-BRANCH
               PERFORM 2210-PERSON-BREAK
               PERFORM 2220-BRANCH-BREAK
               MOVE SR-BRANCH TO WS-SAVE-BRANCH
               MOVE SR-SALESPERSON TO WS-SAVE-PERSON
           ELSE IF SR-SALESPERSON NOT = WS-SAVE-PERSON
               PERFORM 2210-PERSON-BREAK
               MOVE SR-SALESPERSON TO WS-SAVE-PERSON
           END-IF.
       
       2210-PERSON-BREAK.
           MOVE WS-PERSON-TOTAL TO PTL-AMOUNT
           MOVE WS-PERSON-COUNT TO PTL-COUNT
           MOVE WS-PERSON-TOTAL-LINE TO PRINT-LINE
           PERFORM 7000-WRITE-LINE
           MOVE SPACES TO PRINT-LINE
           PERFORM 7000-WRITE-LINE
           MOVE 0 TO WS-PERSON-TOTAL WS-PERSON-COUNT.
       
       2220-BRANCH-BREAK.
           MOVE WS-BRANCH-TOTAL TO BTL-AMOUNT
           MOVE WS-BRANCH-COUNT TO BTL-COUNT
           MOVE WS-BRANCH-TOTAL-LINE TO PRINT-LINE
           PERFORM 7000-WRITE-LINE
           MOVE SPACES TO PRINT-LINE
           PERFORM 7000-WRITE-LINE
           MOVE 0 TO WS-BRANCH-TOTAL WS-BRANCH-COUNT.
       
       2230-REGION-BREAK.
           MOVE WS-REGION-TOTAL TO RTL-AMOUNT
           MOVE WS-REGION-COUNT TO RTL-COUNT
           MOVE WS-REGION-TOTAL-LINE TO PRINT-LINE
           PERFORM 7000-WRITE-LINE
           MOVE SPACES TO PRINT-LINE
           PERFORM 7000-WRITE-LINE
           PERFORM 7000-WRITE-LINE
           MOVE 0 TO WS-REGION-TOTAL WS-REGION-COUNT.
       
       2300-PRINT-DETAIL.
           IF WS-LINE-NUM >= WS-LINES-PER-PAGE
               PERFORM 6000-PAGE-HEADING
           END-IF
           
           MOVE SR-REGION TO DL-REGION
           MOVE SR-BRANCH TO DL-BRANCH
           MOVE SR-SALESPERSON TO DL-PERSON
           MOVE SR-DATE TO DL-DATE
           MOVE SR-AMOUNT TO DL-AMOUNT
           MOVE SR-PRODUCT TO DL-PRODUCT
           MOVE WS-DETAIL-LINE TO PRINT-LINE
           PERFORM 7000-WRITE-LINE.
       
       2400-ACCUMULATE-TOTALS.
           ADD SR-AMOUNT TO WS-PERSON-TOTAL
                           WS-BRANCH-TOTAL
                           WS-REGION-TOTAL
                           WS-GRAND-TOTAL
           ADD 1 TO WS-PERSON-COUNT
                    WS-BRANCH-COUNT
                    WS-REGION-COUNT
                    WS-GRAND-COUNT.
       
       3000-FINAL-TOTALS.
           PERFORM 2210-PERSON-BREAK
           PERFORM 2220-BRANCH-BREAK
           PERFORM 2230-REGION-BREAK
           
           MOVE WS-GRAND-TOTAL TO GTL-AMOUNT
           MOVE WS-GRAND-COUNT TO GTL-COUNT
           MOVE WS-GRAND-TOTAL-LINE TO PRINT-LINE
           PERFORM 7000-WRITE-LINE.
       
       6000-PAGE-HEADING.
           ADD 1 TO WS-PAGE-NUM
           MOVE WS-PAGE-NUM TO H1-PAGE
           
           MOVE WS-HEADER-1 TO PRINT-LINE
           WRITE PRINT-LINE AFTER PAGE
           MOVE WS-HEADER-2 TO PRINT-LINE
           WRITE PRINT-LINE AFTER 1
           MOVE SPACES TO PRINT-LINE
           WRITE PRINT-LINE AFTER 1
           MOVE WS-HEADER-3 TO PRINT-LINE
           WRITE PRINT-LINE AFTER 1
           MOVE ALL '-' TO PRINT-LINE
           WRITE PRINT-LINE AFTER 1
           MOVE 6 TO WS-LINE-NUM.
       
       7000-WRITE-LINE.
           WRITE PRINT-LINE AFTER 1
           ADD 1 TO WS-LINE-NUM.
       
       9000-TERMINATE.
           CLOSE SALES-FILE REPORT-FILE
           DISPLAY 'REPORT COMPLETE: ' WS-GRAND-COUNT ' RECORDS'.
```
